Assertion (A): The Planning Commission formulated poverty lines in India based on nutritional calorie norms.
Reason (R): Y.K. Alagh Task Force (1979) established the benchmark norms of 2400 calories per capita per day in rural areas and 2100 calories in urban areas.
question.ta:
